sys_app.name: SDLC AI Orchestrator
sys_app.short_description: AI-powered SDLC automation: story uplift, code generation, unit tests, ATF creation
sys_app.description: Automates the transition from User Story to Verified Code. Provides LLM-powered story uplift (INVEST + Gherkin), ServiceNow code generation, Jasmine unit test generation, stakeholder test step generation, and automated ATF test suite creation. Integrates with Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs.

sys_rest_message.name: AI LLM API
sys_rest_message.description: Outbound REST integration gateway for LLM providers. Supports Anthropic Claude and OpenAI GPT. API keys are resolved from system properties at runtime via header substitution variables.

sys_properties.name: x_snc_ai_sdlc.llm_provider
sys_properties.description: LLM provider to use for all AI operations. Valid values: anthropic, openai

sys_properties.name: x_snc_ai_sdlc.anthropic_api_key
sys_properties.description: Anthropic API key for Claude models. Set after importing — value is encrypted and intentionally blank in source control.

sys_properties.name: x_snc_ai_sdlc.openai_api_key
sys_properties.description: OpenAI API key for GPT models. Set after importing — value is encrypted and intentionally blank in source control.

sys_properties.name: x_snc_ai_sdlc.anthropic_model
sys_properties.description: Anthropic model ID to use for LLM calls. Default: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022

sys_properties.name: x_snc_ai_sdlc.openai_model
sys_properties.description: OpenAI model ID to use for LLM calls. Default: gpt-4o

sys_properties.name: x_snc_ai_sdlc.llm_max_tokens
sys_properties.description: Maximum number of completion tokens for each LLM call. Default: 4096

sys_properties.name: x_snc_ai_sdlc.llm_temperature
sys_properties.description: Sampling temperature for LLM calls (0.0–1.0). Lower = more deterministic. Default: 0.2

sys_properties.name: x_snc_ai_sdlc.auto_create_manifest
sys_properties.description: Automatically create a pending Story AI Manifest record when a new rm_story is inserted. Default: true

sys_properties.name: x_snc_ai_sdlc.debug_logging
sys_properties.description: Enable verbose gs.log output for all orchestration operations. Visible in System Log. Default: false

sys_script_include.name: PromptTemplates
sys_script_include.description: Centralised LLM prompt library. All prompts instruct the model to return only valid JSON or plain text — no markdown fences. Edit this Script Include to customise AI behaviour without touching orchestration logic.

sys_script_include.name: LLMAPIClient
sys_script_include.description: Low-level HTTP client for LLM APIs. Abstracts Anthropic and OpenAI wire formats. Provider is selected by the x_snc_ai_sdlc.llm_provider system property. Returns a normalised result object from sendMessage().

sys_script_include.name: ATFBuilder
sys_script_include.description: Programmatically creates ATF records (sys_atf_suite, sys_atf_test, sys_atf_step) from a normalised step-definition array. Uses direct GlideRecord inserts to avoid sn_atf API entitlement requirements in scoped apps. Requires the ATF plugin (com.snc.test_management2) to be active.

sys_script_include.name: ManifestHelper
sys_script_include.description: AbstractAjaxProcessor for the AI Command Center UI Page. Provides GlideAjax-callable methods to query manifest status and aggregate dashboard statistics without exposing orchestration internals.

sys_script_include.name: AIOrchestrator
sys_script_include.description: Main pipeline coordinator. Each public method maps to one UI Action on rm_story. Handles manifest lifecycle (find-or-create), status transitions (pending → running → completed/failed), and structured error logging. Depends on PromptTemplates, LLMAPIClient, and ATFBuilder.

sys_ui_action.hint: Rewrite the story description and acceptance criteria using the INVEST framework and Gherkin BDD syntax via AI.
Generate ServiceNow JavaScript artifacts (Script Include, Business Rule, Client Script) from the uplifted story. Run AI: Uplift Story first.
Generate Jasmine unit tests for the generated Script Include and plain-English stakeholder test steps from the acceptance criteria. Run AI: Uplift Story and AI: Generate Code first.
Create ATF Test Suite, Test, and Steps from the uplifted acceptance criteria. Requires the ATF plugin to be active and AI: Uplift Story to have been run first.

sys_script.name: AI SDLC: Auto-Create Story Manifest
sys_script.description: Automatically creates a pending Story AI Manifest record when a new rm_story is inserted. Controlled by the x_snc_ai_sdlc.auto_create_manifest system property.

sys_ui_page.description: AI Command Center — developer dashboard showing AI automation status for all Story AI Manifests. Navigate to x_snc_ai_sdlc_ai_command_center.do
